runs.final_response:
**Success. Charles Babbage was the inventor.** The [Analytical engine article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Analytical_engine) states: “designed by the English mathematician and computer pioneer Charles Babbage.”

Observed route:

1. Opened [Wikipedia](https://www.wikipedia.org/).
2. Entered “Ada Lovelace” in the search field and pressed Return. The [Ada Lovelace article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace) opened.
3. Followed its introductory “analytical engine” link to the article above.

Completed in one attempt. No login, article edits, or navigation outside Wikipedia occurred. The article tab remains open for independent assessment.
